{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (sentinel values)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate patients by keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Confirm the deduplicated dataset has one row per patient
assert df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df_dedup), "Deduplication failed: duplicate patient_id still present"

# Step 4: Compute the mean baseline biomarker value in ng/mL
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the number of patients after filtering and deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of patients after filtering and deduplication: {num_patients}')

# Output the mean
mean_baseline"}
